scope: V78 normal/lab browser integration checker only; neither failure below establishes a product Source regression.

incidents.cause: The checker read pitcher.team from a LivePlayer object without that property. The managed-team menu became empty, so the Host legitimately used AUTO instead of the requested defensive pitch ID.
incidents.correction: Derive the current defensive team from host.match.half. The original timestamped report and receipt log remain unchanged.

incidents.cause: The checker waited for a roster download while its save button remained inside a closed details element. The pending download promise timed out before the click could complete.
incidents.correction: Open the roster details before clicking its actual save button. The original receipt log and partial timestamped report remain unchanged; the nine-inning game had not yet started.

sessionScope: A V78 session replay was verified with the same roster already loaded. The camera session schema does not itself embed that roster.
